- Provide the exact quoted sentence (or a clear paraphrase if you prefer).
- Give the section identifier and page number where it appears (e.g., "Section 2.1 (page 5)").
- Include a brief surrounding context sentence if helpful.
- Note any uncertainty if the text is ambiguous or the location is not exact.

If you want a specific output format, tell me (for example: bullet list with "Section — Page — Quoted text").
